dataset.name: UChicago historical HiDAC-Mito AML cohort (GSE152431)
dataset.description: Independent historical AML treatment cohort with pretreatment bulk RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: This historical comparator comprises 22 patients treated with high-dose cytarabine and mitoxantrone without azacitidine priming. TRACE Explorer retains the single Day-0 RNA profile released for each patient and keeps the cohort separate from the phase I AZA-HiDAC-Mito arm.

metadata.source_program: University of Chicago historical HiDAC-Mito cohort
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and the CC BY 4.0 publication
metadata.library_method: Stranded poly(A)-selected bulk RNA sequencing of pretreatment bone-marrow or peripheral-blood mononuclear cells, aligned to hg19 with STAR 2.5.3
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-provided overall survival in months for the historical HiDAC-Mito cohort
metadata.endpoint_caveat: The public workbook supplies exact individual survival duration and vital status but does not define the clinical time origin. TRACE Explorer preserves the source endpoint without claiming a harmonized diagnosis-, enrollment- or treatment-anchored origin.
metadata.clinical_evidence_note: The pinned GEO sample-information workbook links every historical HiDAC-Mito RNA sample directly to a patient, diagnosis, age, sex, overall-survival duration and vital status.
metadata.sample_selection_note: The CCC-prefixed RNA libraries are the 22 HiDAC-Mito profiles described by the source series. All are Day-0 specimens, all have explicit therapy-related AML labels, and each represents a different patient.
metadata.overlap_note: The historical comparator is separated from the phase I AZA-HiDAC-Mito cohort in the same accession and from the promoted OHSU and AMLCG AML cohorts. Releases are never pooled by default.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the pinned public files in place. Direct source-file redistribution remains disabled under the conservative GEO repository policy.

samples.sample_role: Day-0 bone-marrow or peripheral-blood mononuclear-cell AML specimen collected before HiDAC-Mito

expression.label: GEO raw counts normalized as log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Source-provided gene symbols in the pinned GSE152431 count matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: All 27,945 source gene symbols are unique both exactly and case-insensitively; no implicit aggregation is performed.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer computes library-size CPM across all 27,945 source gene rows for each selected pretreatment specimen and applies log2(CPM + 1). Values are intended for within-cohort analysis.

endpoints.label: Source-provided overall survival
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause according to the source workbook; living patients are censored at the source-provided follow-up duration
